title: feat(cov3split): first 3-site seed where the two cov=66 maximizers disagree
science: Introduces a THIRD selector and it too fails to pick L1 - arguably the most consequential fact in the batch after #6407. Define cov(f) = number of the 66 two-site seeds from which f fills. Exactly two F_cut maps attain the maximum cov=66: (1,1,1,1,0) and (1,1,1,1,1).
